name: 60441 · Lockport, IL
findings: ZIP 60441 (Lockport) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 30 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60441 (Lockport) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60441 (Lockport) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).
